about: DATA for read-data/correct-source-identity.mjs (tool:correct-source-identity). The words a correction writes into the decision and the words it refuses with.
reason: The person asked for cross-chat verification and repair. The original message came from {source_id}. The source identity is verified by the kept message and handoff; delivery and a substantive result require separate live checks.
next_action: Continue handoff {handoff_id} in its original {app} chat {source_id}. Repair the proven continuity breaks and verify its final work result against the same handoff and transcript.
success_measure: Handoff {handoff_id} has a completed substantive outcome and source_return.verified:true from a later final answer in {source_id}; the requested cross-chat behavior is checked live and any remaining failure is recorded truthfully.
move: Keep handoff {handoff_id} open until the original {app} chat returns a verified substantive result.

refuse.unverified: A verified source message, source chat, and handoff are required.
refuse.mismatch: The kept person message and original handoff do not match this decision.
refuse.not_active: This is not an active action decision for the verified source message.
refuse.unproven: This decision does not contain the proven wrong source identity.
